items.question: How does a rite obtained by time become declared both elsewhere and everywhere?
premises: A rite obtained by time is declared elsewhere.
The same rite is declared everywhere.
items.inference: Thus a time-obtained rite is universally declared without repetition fault.
uncertainties: Neuter participle agreement is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: A rite obtained by time is declared elsewhere and everywhere.
